nodes.description: Ownable._owner private address; ownership authority for onlyOwner functions.
_marketingFunds payable address receiving swapped ETH via sendETHToFee.
uniswapV2Router reference set in openTrading and used for swaps/liquidity.
uniswapV2Pair address created in openTrading; used in _transfer gating checks.
_rOwned reflection balance mapping mutated on every transfer.
_tOwned token balance mapping (declared, unused in logic).
_allowances nested mapping written by _approve.
_isExcludedFromFee mapping controlling fee bypass in _transfer.
_rTotal reflection supply reduced by _reflectFee.
_tFeeTotal accumulated fee counter.
_taxFee rate toggled by removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
_teamFee rate (10) toggled by removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
bots mapping marking addresses blocked from transfers.
cooldown mapping of address to next allowed buy timestamp.
botArray list of bot addresses iterated by burnBots.
tradingOpen flag guarding openTrading.
inSwap reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap modifier.
swapEnabled flag enabling auto swap-to-ETH inside _transfer.
cooldownEnabled flag enabling cooldown and uniswap-only checks.
_maxTxAmount cap enforced in _transfer and updated by setMaxTxPercent.
burnAddress destination for burnBots transfers.
_transfer: core internal transfer with bot checks, cooldown, maxTx and ETH swap logic.
_tokenTransfer: applies/removes fees then delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard: mutates _rOwned balances and emits Transfer.
swapTokensForEth: approves router and performs fee-on-transfer token swap to ETH.
sendETHToFee: forwards contract ETH to _marketingFunds via transfer.
openTrading: onlyOwner setup of router, pair, liquidity and limits.
manualswap: marketing-only manual token swap.
manualsend: marketing-only manual ETH forward.
setBots: onlyOwner loop marking addresses as bots.
delBot: onlyOwner removal of a bot flag.
burnBots: onlyOwner loop transferring bot balances to burnAddress.
transfer: ERC20 external transfer entry point.
transferFrom: ERC20 external transfer with allowance decrement.
approve: ERC20 external approval entry point.
setCooldownEnabled: onlyOwner toggles cooldown protection.
_takeTeam: mints reflection share to the contract address.
_reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
setMaxTxPercent: onlyOwner updates _maxTxAmount.
receive: payable fallback accepting ETH from router swaps.
_approve: writes _allowances with zero-address checks.
tokenFromReflection: converts reflection amount to token amount.
_getValues: computes reflection and token fee values.
_getRate: rSupply/tSupply rate used for conversions.
renounceOwnership: onlyOwner sets _owner to zero.
balanceOf: returns token balance via tokenFromReflection.
msg.sender: external caller controlling transfer/approval and owner checks.
block.timestamp: used for cooldown gating and swap/liquidity deadlines.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
External ETH transfer to _marketingFunds from inside transfer flow.
External call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH forwarding contract ETH.
External call to factory.createPair creating the uniswap pair.
Parameter from of _transfer.
Parameter to of _transfer.
Parameter amount of _transfer compared against _maxTxAmount.
Local contractTokenBalance in _transfer.
Local contractETHBalance in _transfer.
Parameter amount of sendETHToFee.
Parameter tokenAmount of swapTokensForEth.
Parameter maxTxPercent of setMaxTxPercent.
Parameter bots_ array of setBots.
Loop index i in setBots.
Parameter notbot of delBot.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from only exists to feed _transfer's sender checks and balance updates.
Parameter to only exists to feed _transfer's recipient checks and balance updates.
Parameter amount only exists to feed _transfer's maxTx check and transfer amount.
Local contractTokenBalance is a temporary derived inside _transfer for the swap call.
Local contractETHBalance is a temporary derived inside _transfer for sendETHToFee.
Parameter amount only exists as the value forwarded by sendETHToFee.
Parameter tokenAmount only exists as the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
Parameter maxTxPercent only exists to compute _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxPercent.
Parameter bots_ only exists as the iteration input of setBots.
Loop index i is a pure iteration temporary of setBots.
Parameter notbot only exists as the address unblocked by delBot.
